dialogueInline.speaker: Parent
dialogueInline.text: Is this the line for the garden or the water?

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: Neither line should be here. One moment.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: I'll move the refill stand out of their way.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: I'll keep these families here for a moment.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya Serrano
dialogueInline.text: I can give you a hand.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: Good. That child can't see past the banners.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 5 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Rafael “Raf” Morales
dialogueInline.text: She's got the water. Look at the bottle.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kyler Chen
dialogueInline.text: I just need the scan.

dialogueInline.speaker: Guest 1
dialogueInline.text: My phone's at the bottom of my bag.

dialogueInline.speaker: Rafael “Raf” Morales
dialogueInline.text: That's the safest place for it. Water's already in the bottle.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kyler Chen
dialogueInline.text: I have to count the refill somehow.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: Count it at the register. She's already finished.

dialogueInline.speaker: Rafael “Raf” Morales
dialogueInline.text: I told you I was reliable.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 5 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: One app. Every activity, right there.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: Then you get to help everyone download it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: That sounded easier in my head.

dialogueInline.speaker: Guest 1
dialogueInline.text: Can I refill without a phone? Mine's dying.

dialogueInline.speaker: Rafael “Raf” Morales
dialogueInline.text: You're holding a perfectly good bottle.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kyler Chen
dialogueInline.text: The register keeps a count.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: Great. Now nobody has to photograph their water.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 5 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Sponsor Representative
dialogueInline.text: Fifty thousand was the headline.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: I know. I wrote it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sponsor Representative
dialogueInline.text: Then what happened?

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: Families skipped stamps to watch the reef. We kept pointing them back to the table.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kyler Chen
dialogueInline.text: We have a smaller count we can verify.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sponsor Representative
dialogueInline.text: Show me what people actually did. And keep the number honest.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 5 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: Eighteen thousand four hundred twelve.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sponsor Representative
dialogueInline.text: I preferred fifty thousand.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kyler Chen
dialogueInline.text: Everybody did.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sponsor Representative
dialogueInline.text: Are you sure of this number?

dialogueInline.speaker: Kyler Chen
dialogueInline.text: I checked the records twice.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sponsor Representative
dialogueInline.text: And the children we watched?

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: They're at the jellyfish glass again. Their passports are in their pockets.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sponsor Representative
dialogueInline.text: Then that's the number we use.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: The board will call.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sponsor Representative
dialogueInline.text: Let them call me.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 5 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Sponsor Representative
dialogueInline.text: You didn't finish the passport?

dialogueInline.speaker: Turtle-Helmet Kid
dialogueInline.text: No. We found this tiny fish under a root, and then there were loads more.

dialogueInline.speaker: Father
dialogueInline.text: We nearly missed the jellyfish gallery because he wouldn't leave.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sponsor Representative
dialogueInline.text: Did you?
